name: Phenobarbital
toxicity: potentially lethal when mixed with depressants like alcohol or opioids
summary: CNS depressant that is typically used for insomnia in older patients and epliepsy in younger patients. Less commonlly used now medically due to a popular preference for benzodiazepines.

pharmacology.text: Phenobarbital acts as an allosteric modulator which extends the amount of time the chloride ion channel is open by interacting with GABAA receptor subunits. Through this action, phenobarbital increases the flow of chloride ions into the neuron which decreases the excitability of the post-synaptic neuron. Hyperpolarizing this post-synaptic membrane leads to a decrease in the general excitatory aspects of the post-synaptic neuron.

uses.text: Phenobarbital, sold under the brand name Luminal among others, is a medication of the barbiturate type. It is recommended by the World Health Organization (WHO) for the treatment of certain types of epilepsy in developing countries. In the developed world, it is commonly used to treat seizures in young children, while other medications are generally used in older children and adults.
uses.routes: By mouth, rectal, parenteral, intramuscular, intravenous

sideEffects.text: Potentially serious side effects include a decreased level of consciousness and respiratory depression.

summaryZh: 苯巴比妥，以Luminal等品牌名稱於市場上銷售，是一種巴比妥類藥物。世界衛生組織 建議開發中國家用它來治療特定類型的癲癇。它在已開發國家通常用於治療新生兒癲癇發作，而對年齡較大的兒童和成人的癲癇發作則普遍使用其他藥物來治療。此藥物也用於獸醫學用途。
summaryZhHans: 苯巴比妥，以Luminal等品牌名称于市场上销售，是一种巴比妥类药物。世界卫生组织 建议发展中国家用它来治疗特定类型的癫痫。它在发达国家通常用于治疗新生儿癫痫发作，而对年龄较大的儿童和成人的癫痫发作则普遍使用其他药物来治疗。此药物也用于兽医学用途。

fact.en: Phenobarbital reached the market in 1912 as Luminal and was the first effective epilepsy medicine. It is still on the World Health Organization's list of essential medicines.
fact.zh: 苯巴比妥在 1912 年以 Luminal 的商品名上市，是第一個有效的抗癲癇藥，至今仍列於世界衛生組織的基本藥物清單中。
fact.zhHans: 苯巴比妥在 1912 年以 Luminal 的商品名上市，是第一个有效的抗癫痫药，至今仍列于世界卫生组织的基本药物清单中。
